ServicesPage.title: Our Professional Services
ServicesPage.subtitle: At Touchup Building Maintenance, we provide a comprehensive suite of high-quality services to ensure your home or office is in pristine condition.

painting.title: Painting Work
painting.description: Professional interior and exterior painting services to give your property a fresh new look.
painting.details: Transform your space with our professional painting services. We use high-quality paints and materials for a durable and beautiful finish. Our team ensures clean work with proper surface preparation and post-painting cleanup.

electrical-repair.title: Electrical Work
electrical-repair.description: Safe and reliable electrical services, from minor repairs to complete wiring solutions.
electrical-repair.details: Our certified electricians handle all types of electrical work, including fixing short circuits, installing new light fixtures, socket replacements, and comprehensive electrical safety checks for your home or office.

plumbing.title: Plumbing
plumbing.description: Comprehensive plumbing solutions for leaks, blockages, installations, and emergency repairs.
plumbing.details: From leaky faucets to major pipe bursts, our skilled plumbers are available 24/7. We offer pipe repair, drain cleaning, water heater installation, and bathroom/kitchen fixture installation services.

cleaning-services.title: Cleaning Services
cleaning-services.description: Thorough cleaning services for homes and offices, leaving your space spotless and fresh.
cleaning-services.details: Our cleaning service covers every nook and cranny of your property. We use eco-friendly products and professional equipment to ensure a healthy environment.

pest-control.title: Pest Control
pest-control.description: Effective and safe pest control solutions to protect your home from unwanted intruders.
pest-control.details: We provide comprehensive pest control services for common pests in Dubai like cockroaches, ants, bed bugs, and rodents. Our treatments are safe for your family and pets, ensuring a pest-free environment.

AboutPage.title: About Touchup Building Maintenance
AboutPage.subtitle: Your dedicated partner in home maintenance, committed to quality and excellence.
AboutPage.whoWeAreP1: Touchup Building Maintenance was founded with a simple mission: to make professional home maintenance services accessible and hassle-free for everyone in Dubai. With years of experience in the industry, our founders noticed a gap in the market for a reliable, customer-centric service provider that homeowners and businesses could truly depend on.
AboutPage.whoWeAreP2: Today, we are a leading name in home maintenance, with a growing team of skilled, certified, and passionate technicians. We are proud to have served over 500 homes and businesses, building a reputation for quality, integrity, and exceptional customer care.
AboutPage.missionText: To provide reliable, high-quality, and affordable home maintenance and cleaning solutions that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring their spaces are safe, comfortable, and pristine.
AboutPage.visionText: To be Dubai's most trusted and sought-after home services company, known for our professionalism, efficiency, and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.
AboutPage.valuesText: We operate with integrity, professionalism, and a strong work ethic. We believe in building long-term relationships with our clients based on trust and exceptional service.
